thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High 5xx spike on /v1/generate for model 'redwood-small-quant-v2' (version: candidate-2026-03-15-shardmap) - 12% error rate over 5m, elevated latency.
jamie (oncall): on it. pulling logs now. any customer-facing alerts?
incident-bot: No automated public alerts. Top affected route: chat.generate, region: us-east-1.
kevin (runtime): I see a pattern: tokenizer decode errors + BadToken errors in the decoder worker for shard_index=2. suspect tokenizer mismatch with new weights.
oliver (sre): can you paste the error snippet?
kevin (runtime): ``
ERROR DecoderWorker: token id 32890 not in vocab range (vocab_size=50257)
Traceback (most recent call last):... TokenizerDecodeError: unknown token id
``
jamie (oncall): that's consistent with a vocab different from weights. Did the deploy pipeline pick the wrong tokenizer artifact?
maria (prod): deploy logs show artifact tag candidate-2026-03-15 used for weights, tokenizer tag used was candidate-2026-03-14. There was a race in tag promotion.
oliver (sre): oh :grimacing: that would explain it. Customers might see gibberish or 5xxs when sampling hits out-of-vocab ids.
sophie (cs): any data on impacted customers? Which tenants saw errors?
kevin (runtime): top 3 orgs by errors: org-abb, org-polaris, org-saasly. Combined ~7% of active requests during window.
jamie (oncall): @sophie please prepare a holding message: "We're investigating a generation degradation for some customers; mitigation in progress."
sophie (cs): on it. preparing now.
jamie (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag to route to stable model for all traffic (kill candidate) 2) roll back candidate deployment 3) if needed, re-promote tokenizer + weights together. Can we toggle flag quickly?
deploy-bot: Feature flag toggle accepted. Executing: `POST /flags/route_model {"model":"redwood-small-quant-v2","target":"stable"}`
deploy-bot: Done. Traffic routing change propagated to 95% of nodes (ETA 20s).
jamie (oncall): monitoring...
kevin (runtime): seeing drop in errors to baseline after flag flip. latency normalizing.
incident-bot: [METRIC] 5xx rate on /v1/generate down from 12% -> 1.5% over 2 minutes.
maria (prod): good. next step: rollback candidate deployment from cluster pool and ensure tokenizer artifact is pinned with weights before next rollout.
oliver (sre): initiating rollback now. Command: ``kubectl rollout undo deploy/redwood-gen-candidate --to-revision=stable-revision``
deploy-bot: Rollback started. Notifying infra to drain candidate instances for safe termination.
jamie (oncall): @kevin after rollback, can you run a verification job (sanity prompts across shards) to confirm no decode errors?
kevin (runtime): running quick verify script: ``python tools/verify_tokenizer_weights.py --model redwood-small-quant-v2 --shards all``
kevin (runtime): initial results: stable revision passes, candidate revision fails on shard=2 with TokenizerDecodeError 100% on synthetic seeds.
sophie (cs): drafted customer note: "We've mitigated an issue causing degraded generation for a subset of customers by routing traffic to the stable model. We're continuing to investigate root cause and will follow up with timeline for a safe redeploy." Want to send out now?
maria (prod): hold until incident summary updated. we'll send to impacted customers within next 30m.
oliver (sre): rolling status: rollback complete on 8/8 nodes. no new 5xx spikes.
jamie (oncall): handing off to @kevin for post-rollback verification and to own the postmortem. I'm going offshift in 30m.
kevin (runtime): ack. I'll collect artifacts: deploy pipeline logs, artifact tags, checksum diffs between tokenizer candidates, and shard allocation map.
incident-bot: [NOTE] Pager interval extended to 1h for follow-up.
jamie (oncall): quick blameless note: root cause candidate: tag promotion race where weights and tokenizer were not atomically pinned; resulting in mismatched vocab causing decode errors on specific shard mapping.
maria (prod): mitigation checklist: - feature flag kill-switch (done) - rollback (done) - customer notifications (pending) - postmortem (assigned to kevin) - pipeline fix: enforce atomic artifact promotion (action: eng-platform)
kevin (runtime): creating incident doc in /incidents/postmortems with initial timeline and logs.
sophie (cs): ready to send customer messages once kev confirms list of impacted org IDs.
kevin (runtime): confirmed list attached to incident doc. sending to cs now.
sophie (cs): message sent to affected customers. no escalations so far. some customers reported short-term garbled outputs, all restored after routing switch.
jamie (oncall): ok. if anything flares, page me. otherwise I'll sign off. :thumbsup:
oliver (sre): adding runbook item: verify artifact tag parity before rollout; automated check to compare tokenizer vocab hash vs weights-vocab-hash.
maria (prod): assigning eng-platform ticket: PLATFORM-5823.
kevin (runtime): I will drive the postmortem. initial severity: Sev2 (customer impact, mitigated quickly).
incident-bot: [CLOSED] Incident major vector mitigated. Follow-up tasks created.
jamie (oncall): thanks team. handoff complete.
